## 2026-11-11T17:24Z Contrast blocker root-caused and repo repaired

- The contrast failures blocking #276 and #277 are two unrelated defects, not one regression.
- `scripts/rendered-contrast.mjs` preferred a text element's own opaque background over measured pixels. Four paint-order tests expect the pixel verdict for overlap and pseudo paint, so they false-passed. The shortcut was introduced, reverted, restored, and broadened between Nov 9 18:16 and Nov 10 20:50.
- The fix keeps the self-background shortcut for partially covering plates (the coverage-item false positive) but requires pixel evidence when the DOM reports paint it cannot prove (`requires rendered review`).
- `tests/creative-promotion.test.ts` omitted `data-ll-surface` on its contact section. `--ll-focus` therefore fell back to `currentColor`, painting a white focus ring on cream at 1.08:1. The fixture now marks the page surface.
- Validation on the rebased branch: paint 24/24, contrast and static suites 160/160, both creative-promotion cases pass. `npm run check` not rerun after the rebase; PR validation is the gate.
- The shared checkout's object store was corrupted by an interrupted concurrent operation: four zero-byte loose objects and a zero-length `codex/launchloom-repair-handoff` ref. Removed the empty objects and ref, re-fetched `origin/main`, and `git fsck` is clean.
- Branch `codex/launchloom-contrast-flatpair` also carries the Playwright install fallback. It is pushed for review.
- The issue 278 lifecycle run was cancelled while queued; it will be restarted after this fix lands.
- PR validation also exposed a stale OIDC authorization test: the new focused lane legitimately mints `id-token: write`. The test now allows exactly the generation and focused jobs and still rejects every other job.

## 2026-11-11T20:05Z Lazy media gate repair

- The issue 278 pack run built successfully but failed rendered verification on every viewport: "Page assets load and have explicit alt attributes."
- The page's secondary image is a reachable Unsplash asset rendered with `loading="lazy"` below the fold. The verifier evaluated `complete && naturalWidth` without scrolling or forcing the request, so it judged an image the browser had not fetched yet.
- The media check now sets each `main img` to eager and waits for load or error before judging. A missing asset still fails; a valid lazy asset no longer fails on scroll position.
- Added a regression test with a lazy image 10,000px below the fold.
- Next: merge this gate repair, then rerun the pack lifecycle for issue 278.
